description: Comptage vélo Eco-Counter is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Toulouse Métropole. Jeu de données des comptages journaliers vélo sur Toulouse Métropole. Un site de comptage peut être équipé d'un seul compteur dans le cas d'un aménagement cyclable unidirectionnel ou de deux compteurs dans le cas d'un aménagement cyclable bi-directionnel. Ces compteurs peuvent être placés sur des pistes cyclables, des bandes cyclables ou des voies vertes. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are comptage, vélo, trafic. The portal shows 39,014 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-06-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
